description: Add 7 new requirements (K3, K6, K7, W1, W2, W3, W4) to specs/hanashite-tsukurun/requirements.md as requirements 11-17, following the exact same format as existing requirements 1-10. Also add new glossary terms for new concepts introduced.
steps: Add new glossary terms to the Glossary section in requirements.md: Layout_Variation, Slide_Animation, Marp_Custom_Theme, Structure_Visualizer, Step_Guide, Question_Rationale, Completion_Feedback, and any other terms referenced by new requirements
Add 要件11: レイアウトバリエーション (K3) - Each slide page has a different Marp layout based on structural role (lead for page 1, two-column for page 2, centered+gradient for page 3). Uses Marp _class directives.
Add 要件12: アニメーション付きスライド出力 (K6) - CSS animations on the finish screen: fade-in for title, slide-up for body text, scale-up for icon, slide/fade page transitions. Pure CSS.
Add 要件13: Marp出力の本格品質向上 (K7) - Enhanced Marp output: bold/quotes/emoji in text, header/footer with theme title and author, custom Marp theme (hanashite-pop), professional formatting.
Add 要件14: リアルタイム構造ビジュアライザー (W1) - Replace simple progress bar with a presentation structure map showing WHY each step exists with icon and explanation for each step.
Add 要件15: プレゼンガイドの「作りながら表示」(W2) - Show mini-guide after each step completes (not just finish screen), teaching presentation structure experientially.
Add 要件16: AI質問の「なぜこの質問をするのか」表示 (W3) - Show hint bubble below AI speech explaining WHY the question is asked, with toggle ON/OFF.
Add 要件17: 完成スライドの「良いところフィードバック」(W4) - AI provides specific positive comments about the child's presentation after completion.
Ensure all acceptance criteria use WHEN/THE/SHALL/IF/THEN format with numbered items, matching existing style precisely
acceptance_criteria: requirements.md contains 要件11 through 要件17 after the existing 要件10
Each new requirement has a ユーザーストーリー section
Each new requirement has numbered 受入基準 using WHEN/THE/SHALL/IF/THEN format
New glossary terms are added to the Glossary section
All new content is written in Japanese matching existing style
Requirements reference existing glossary terms where applicable (e.g., Marp, Slide_Preview, AI_Character, Progress_Bar, etc.)
verification: Read specs/hanashite-tsukurun/requirements.md and confirm requirements 11-17 exist with proper format
Verify glossary section has new terms
